title: 4. KCPE Declaration by the School Headteacher
text:
THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL
Ref: KNEC/EA/EM/ KCPE/REG/001/2022/REV 7.1
 2022 KCPE ENTRIES
 To be completed in Triplicate: ORIGINAL TO BE RETURNED TO KNEC TOGETHER WITH
 ENTRIES, DUPLICATE TO BE RETAINED BY THE SUB COUNTY DIRECTOR OF EDUCATION AND
 TRIPLICATE TO REMAIN AT SCHOOL
 DECLARATION BY THE SCHOOL HEADTEACHER
 FILL IN THE BLANKS
1. I declare that I have:
 (i). Presented all candidates who have been learning in this school and are eligible
 for registration;
 (ii). Checked and confirmed that candidates’ names are correct and not duplicated;
 (iii). Verified the index numbers and there are no gaps;
 (iv). Checked and confirmed that the subject entries for candidates with special
 needs and Religious Education option are correctly captured.
 I also declare that I will not present any other candidate(s) for this year’s examination.
 The following is the summary of my entries:
 (i). CRE--------------------------------------
 (ii). IRE---------------------------------------
 (iii). HRE--------------------------------------
 (iv). Kenya Sign Language (KSL) ----------------------------
 TOTAL-----------------------------------
2. I have attached this declaration form for my school and presented the same to the
 Sub County Director of Education for onward transmission to the Kenya National
 Examinations Council.
